prompt.project_info: Candid three-quarter rear beach fashion portrait at sunset.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long wet-textured dirty-blonde hair, light makeup and blue-green eyes, looking back toward camera, wearing a blue floral string bikini and small hoop earrings; natural tanned skin with realistic moisture sheen.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium shot from mid-thigh up, weight shifted to one leg and torso turned over shoulder, framed by a silver umbrella pole at left, pebble beach, calm ocean, distant mountains and sunset sky behind.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm backlit sunset with soft frontal fill, rim light on wet hair, dramatic orange-to-blue sky, relaxed confident beach mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 35-50mm natural perspective, deep but atmospheric depth of field, sharp subject, realistic wet hair and fabric, photorealistic candid capture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical photorealistic sunset beach fashion portrait of one generic approved adult woman with long wet-textured dirty-blonde hair and light makeup, wearing a blue floral string bikini and small hoop earrings, standing in a three-quarter rear pose and looking back toward camera; silver umbrella pole at left, pebble shore, calm ocean, distant mountains and dramatic orange-blue sunset sky, warm rim light and soft fill.
